stemMd: Every document in an empty folder is signed. In ordinary classical logic, what follows about signed documents elsewhere?

options.label: A
options.textMd: At least one signed document must exist elsewhere.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Nothing about whether signed documents exist elsewhere

options.label: E
options.textMd: At least one unsigned document exists elsewhere.

explanationMd: A universal statement over an empty collection is true without any member satisfying its predicate. It supplies no information about documents outside that collection.

distractorRationale.a: A universal statement about an empty set supplies no existence claim.
distractorRationale.c: The statement applies only to this folder.
distractorRationale.b: The folder says nothing about other locations.
distractorRationale.e: No external existence claim is supplied.
